lines.zh: 我在浅水里游，身子歪着。
lines.en: I swim the shallows crookedly.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破破烂烂，划得很慢。
lines.en: My fins are ragged and they pull slowly.
I keep to the mud on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我沿着水沟往前，水是黄浊的。
lines.en: I follow the ditch; the water is yellow and thick.

lines.zh: 我游过去时水草都倒向一边。
lines.en: The weeds bend aside as I pass.

lines.zh: 我一段一段地挪，喘不上气。
lines.en: I move in short stretches, short of breath.

lines.zh: 我在水面下浮着，像块烂木。
lines.en: I float under the surface like rotten wood.
I slip around a sunken stone.
My tail beats without strength.

lines.zh: 我从枯水洼爬进另一片水。
lines.en: I drag from one dried pool into another.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方水变凉了。
lines.en: The water cools where I've been.
I work along the bank.
My gills work with difficulty.

lines.zh: 我转了个圈，回到深一点的地方。
lines.en: I turn a circle back to deeper water.
Half my body is in the mud.

lines.zh: 我朝着有水声的地方游。
lines.en: I swim toward the sound of water.
I stop and drift with the water.

lines.zh: 水里的泥在我身边沉下去。
lines.en: The mud settles around me.
I'm hungry, too hungry to move.
My belly is sunken flat.
I float on the surface of this starved water.
I press my mouth to the surface and draw a breath.

lines.zh: 水草缠在我身上，我没理。
lines.en: Weeds tangle on me; I ignore them.
Light shifts across the surface.
I wait for the same kind of prey to come near.
I've caught nothing.
One fin moves slowly.

lines.zh: 我漂到一块石头旁边靠着。
lines.en: I drift against a stone and rest.
You stand at the water's edge; I see you.
The water at your feet is shallow.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪了一点。
lines.en: I shift a little your way.
You can't see me in the mud.
Your shadow falls on the water.
I raise my dorsal fin slowly.
I smell warmth on you.
Will you come into the water? Better still.
I roll over, fins flailing.

lines.zh: 这一下把我按进了泥里。
lines.en: The blow presses me into the mud.
Water coughs out of my gills.
My body shudders once.
My swimming gets more crooked.
I burrow under the roots of the weed.
Red threads leak from my gills.
I press to the bottom and stay still.
I can still swim, only slower.
I raise my head and keep waiting.
That bit is floating on the surface.
I swim over and open my mouth.
I find it's already soft.
I take it and pull it under.
One bite and it's gone.

lines.zh: 我吞的时候水也进去了。
lines.en: Water goes down with it.
I finish it and stay put.
I raise my head and keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我撞在水草上，缠了一下。
lines.en: I hit the weeds and tangle briefly.
I sink into the mud to just my back.
The impact muddies the water.
I'm pushed onto the shallows and flounder.
I right myself with effort.
We squeeze past each other in the water.
I stick to your leg and slide off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢回到深一点的地方。
lines.en: I drift back to deeper water.
She swims the shallows too.
She's lost more scales than I have.
We swim side by side, neither fast.
She nudges my flank with her head.
The water between us is muddy.
We search the same water.
She's thinner even than I am.
She swims off; I don't follow.
This pool is enough for both of us.
The weeds tangle on me again.
I open my mouth and take it.
I swallow it with difficulty.
I spit it out and take it again.
It's covered in mud.
I press it to the bottom.
I can't swim dragging it.

lines.zh: 这点太小了，我差点没咬到。
lines.en: It's so small I nearly missed.
No sooner eaten than hungry again.
I let it back into the water.
A tremor of footsteps reaches me through the mud.
I raise my head and spread my fins.
This one I can drain dry.
I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃到活的了。
lines.en: It's been a long time since I ate something alive.
I'm in no hurry; it can't go fast.
I open my mouth and wait.
It's walking into the water.
I've fixed on its position.
I follow below the surface, slowly.
Its feet stir up mud.
I swim right at its ankle.
It doesn't feel anything wrong yet.
The water carries it toward me.
I hold my mouth open, waiting.
It's heading back for the bank.

lines.zh: 太浅了，我够不到那么高。
lines.en: Too shallow up there for me.

lines.zh: 它的影子在水面上歪了。
lines.en: Its shadow on the water tilts.
I've bitten, and I won't let go.
I pull, and the blood comes.
It kicks and I hang on.
This bite lands somewhere soft.
What I drain is more than what I eat.

lines.zh: 它的力气顺着水到我身上。
lines.en: Its strength comes to me through the water.
It stomps; I sink into the mud.
It's struggling even to stand now.
My round mouth seals against its skin.
At last it falls into the water.
A few bubbles rise in the pool.
I rise out of the mud.
My fins are shredded like rags.
This water is shallow and muddy.
I open my mouth and test it.
I beat my tail slowly; I can move.
The grass on the bank is all dead.
I swim a little deeper.
I hear something approaching.
I sink, leaving only my fin.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats up and I drive for the bottom.

lines.zh: 我落在硬地上，蹦了两下。
lines.en: I land on hard ground and flop twice.

lines.zh: 水一下变深，我沉了下去。
lines.en: The water deepens and I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把水和泥一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast throws up water and mud.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过了我的鳍。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my fin.

lines.zh: 那道光让我身上的力气被抽走。
lines.en: The light drains the strength out of me.

lines.zh: 我本来就饿，现在更没劲了。
lines.en: I was hungry; now I'm weaker still.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整个僵了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我干得发疼。
lines.en: There's no water here and I ache with dryness.
